title: fagerlindia griffithii
intro: Fagerlindia griffithii, commonly known as Griffith's fagerlindia or Fagerlindia griffithii, is a plant species that belongs to the family of flowering plants, Rutaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Fagerlindia griffithii include limonoids, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of providing relief from pain, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Fagerlindia griffithii are mainly attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress.
